mission: Helping people find their people: to know God, belong to a community, and serve the neighbors around us.
story: Grace Community started in 1998 as a handful of families meeting in a Springfield living room. Today we gather on Maple Ridge Road for three services a week, with a kids ministry, student ministry and a network of small groups that meet all over town.

We have always believed a church works best when it feels small. However many people walk through the doors on Sunday, we want each one to be known by name, to have a table to sit at, and to have a place to use their gifts.

values.title: Welcome first
values.text: Come as you are. Nobody has to have it figured out to belong here.

values.title: Rooted in Scripture
values.text: We teach the Bible plainly and trust it to speak for itself.

values.title: Life together
values.text: Faith is not a solo project. We grow in groups, meals and long conversations.

values.title: Sent to serve
values.text: The mission reaches past our walls: our neighbors, our city and the world.
